# scripts/release-ci-gate.sh reads this list when the token it runs with cannot
# read main's branch protection, which is always the case inside release.yml
# (GITHUB_TOKEN has no repository administration access). A release is refused
# unless every name here is a job of the commit's green tests.yml run and that
# job concluded success, so keep this list in step with branch protection: add a
# name when it becomes required and remove it when it stops being required. Run
# the gate with a token that can read protection to see any difference.
